name: Voice notes
author: Brett
description: Only a settings interface: sets up a voice-activated notes pusher. A start trigger, a beep, the note, a stop trigger (cut from the text and the recording), then it asks where to store it: say a list, or "give me the list of lists" and it reads them with their numbers, and you say a number. Each list can ask its own questions, opened by a number or a recorded trigger, and file notes into subcategories. Settings and lists live on axHub's data server through the framework's lib-hubstore, never on this device. The listener itself is a placeholder (axf.voice-notes.listener).
